title: Ferg's Sports Bar prepares to host the big show
text:
For as long as Tampa Bay has had baseball, we have had Ferg's 
 Advertisement Culture 
 At Ferg’s, the Rays’ home away from home, the World Series party is just starting
 The iconic sports bar across from Tropicana Field is preparing for a wild and wonderful week.     .   Mark Ferguson, owner of Ferg's Sports Bar & Grill, unpacks a shipment of beer on Friday as he and his staff set up for a huge week, with the Tampa Bay Rays playing in the World Series. [ DIRK SHADD | Times ] Lane DeGregory is an enterprise reporter covering the people of Tampa Bay. She can be reached at ldegregory@tampabay.com.
